docs.purpose: The web REPORT renderer: ReportPage.tsx draws the v21 report page view (sections, parts, the detail sheet, the footer) for the MaxBLD report page; ReportView.tsx draws the earlier report view and the Picture; ReportPageToggles.tsx is the client toggle script of the page. It is the landed renderer Spec 126 section 11b.1 keeps ("REPORT keeps the landed renderer"); it is a component, not a library binding.
docs.data_story: It reads nothing itself: the page passes the page view (built and checked on the server by buildPage / pageViewOf) and the content strings.
docs.under_126: **OWNER ENTRY** (task-384 STD.REPORT-OWN, dated 2026-11-20): a platform_shared census entry that owns the web REPORT renderer files so R-13 totality holds for them. The files stay a component (Spec 126 section 11b.1, :923). They are not yet listed in bindings.json modules, so the FE-31 text (C-2b) and component (C-8) checks do not judge them: C-3 needs their module root to be a frontend glob in mcbylaws/protected-paths.json (operator question).

identity.owner: Admin domain (Spec 126 §14 Target Files) — the conversion programme owns the row; no individual owner is named by Specs 126/127/128.

versioning.why: The renderer has no wire contract of its own: its input is the page view (report-page.schema.json) and its output is markup. A change shows up as a golden or render-smoke failure.

inputs.why: The page view, the lifecycle state and the content strings arrive as props from the page.

state.why: No store: the open panels and the detail sheet are page-local UI state toggled by ReportPageToggles.tsx, never persisted.

staleness.why: It renders what it is given.

session.why: Its consumer is the MaxBLD report page behind the parcel_tool gate; each consumer declares its own guard.

rls_class.why: It renders the report page view the consumer already read; it reads no table itself.

checks.why: The three files are owned by this entry (Spec 128 R-13 totality); listing them in bindings.json modules is owed (see docs).

errors.why: Errors belong to the consuming page.

offers.why: It renders the ad sections the server placed (their Sponsored disclosure as sent); it decides no placement.

metering.why: Rendering is not a metered product action.

config.why: No tunable of its own: the binding consumes no registered logic variable; the layout row (report-layout.json) is read by the server projection, not here.

sharing.why: Every web REPORT surface (the MaxBLD report page).
sharing.varies_by_surface: Only the page view and content passed in.

limitations.what: The three owned files (src/components/report/ReportPage.tsx, ReportView.tsx, ReportPageToggles.tsx) are outside the FE-31 text check C-2b, the component check C-8 and the 44 px check C-9: none of them reads these files. C-2b and C-8 read only the files listed in bindings.json mounts and modules, and these three are not listed (owed: C-3 needs src/components/report/ as a frontend glob in mcbylaws/protected-paths.json, an operator item). C-9 reads golden nodes, not source files.
limitations.measured: Ownership only (Spec 128 R-13). Treated as web REPORT modules, a lane measure run raised 108 C-2b and 213 C-8 findings (docs/reports/lanes/2026-11-20/BL-REPORTOWN/measure-before.txt); no 44 px measure exists.

notes: task-384 STD.REPORT-OWN (dated 2026-11-20). Archetype REPORT, the archetype of the modules it owns. The census ref S-095 is claimed in the ID ledger (S-094 was the last). Dated note 2026-11-20 (grounder, task-384): limitations states the three files are outside C-2b, C-8 and C-9; deviations, touch_target_min_px, labels and dark_mode carry the schema value UNRESEARCHED (copied values from the mobile entry measured nothing here).

programme.why: Shared rendering infrastructure: the renderer every web REPORT page draws through (owner entry only).
